High-strength, porous additively manufactured implants with optimized mechanical osseointegration.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Cambre N Kelly, Tian Wang, James Crowley, Dan Wills, Matthew H Pelletier et al. Biomaterials 2021-12-01 10.1016/j.biomaterials.2021.121206
单位: Pratt School of Engineering, Duke University, Durham, NC, USA.
通讯: William R Walsh @ Surgical and Orthopaedic Research Laboratories (SORL), Prince of Wales Clinical School UNSW Sydney, Kensington, Australi
相关性: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制造的多孔钛合金植入物的力学性能与骨整合关系，为AM生物医学材料方向提供了关键实验证据。
边界: This paper does not report fatigue testing or as-built surface roughness characterization.
动机· 优化多孔钛合金植入物的孔隙率与力学性能平衡，以促进骨整合
方法· 采用LPBF制造不同孔隙率的多孔钛合金支架，通过绵羊模型体内植入评估骨整合
结果· 发现孔隙率与力学性能呈线性关系，而与骨-植入物界面剪切强度呈非线性关系
验证· 通过绵羊皮质骨和松质骨缺损模型进行体内验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To optimize the tradeoff between porosity and mechanical properties in porous titanium alloy scaffolds for improved load sharing and osseointegration.
Method· Porous titanium alloy scaffolds with porosity ranging from 0% to 90% were fabricated via LPBF and implanted in an ovine cortical and cancellous defect model.
Result· A linear relationship was observed between porosity and benchtop mechanical properties, while the ex vivo bone-implant interfacial shear strength exhibited a nonlinear dependence on porosity.
Validation· The study employed an established ovine animal model with both cortical and cancellous bone defects to validate the in vivo osseointegration performance.

相关性: 该论文直接针对髋关节假体脱粘与稳定性问题，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: The paper does not report stress/strain in Gruen zones or compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 模拟部分骨整合假体的脱粘过程以评估长期稳定性。
方法· 采用NURBS增强接触单元和修正库仑摩擦模型的三维有限元接触公式。
结果· 成功模拟了髋关节假体的脱粘行为，揭示了部分骨整合对稳定性的影响。
验证· 通过数值算例验证了接触模型的有效性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To simulate the debonding process of partially osseointegrated cementless implants for assessing long-term stability.
Method· A 3D FE frictional contact formulation with NURBS-enriched contact elements and a modified Coulomb friction law with smooth transition between friction coefficients.
Result· The model successfully simulated hip implant debonding and demonstrated the influence of partial osseointegration on implant stability.
Validation· Validation was performed through numerical simulation cases without experimental data.

相关性: 该论文研究了3D打印多孔钛合金椎间融合器在羊体内的骨整合效果，但未涉及应力遮挡或刚度匹配，也未进行机械测试。
边界: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching; no mechanical testing (static or fatigue); no surface roughness or as-built morphology analysis.
动机· 比较3D打印多孔钛合金、标准钛合金和PEEK椎间融合器的骨整合效果
方法· 在羊腰椎融合模型中植入三种融合器，用显微CT和组织形态学评估骨体积和骨接触率
结果· 3D打印组6周时骨长入和骨接触率显著高于其他两组，12周时骨长入无差异但骨接触率仍高

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare osseointegration of 3D-printed porous titanium-alloy interbody spacers with conventional solid titanium-alloy and PEEK spacers in an ovine lumbar fusion model.
Method· Eighteen sheep underwent two-level lateral lumbar interbody fusion with randomized spacer types, and bone ingrowth (BV) and ongrowth (BAR) were quantified using micro-CT and histomorphometry at 6 and 12 weeks.
Result· The 3D-printed group showed significantly higher bone volume at 6 weeks and significantly greater bone apposition ratio at both time points compared to PEEK and standard titanium groups.
Validation· In vivo preclinical animal study with histomorphometric and micro-CT analysis.

边界: No stress shielding analysis, no LPBF fabrication details, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and surface roughness not reported.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a bone substitute with both anti-osteosarcoma and bone repair functions using 3D-printed titanium alloy implants loaded with cisplatin via a thermosensitive hydrogel.
Method· Cisplatin was incorporated into PLGA-PEG-PLGA hydrogel and loaded into porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds fabricated by 3D printing.
Result· The drug-loaded implants reduced tumor volume by over two-thirds with minimal organ damage and maintained acceptable osseointegration at 8 weeks.
Validation· In vivo evaluation using tumor-bearing mouse and bone defect rabbit models.

Motivation· To design porous implants that match the stiffness of patient bone to mitigate stress shielding and promote osseointegration.
Method· A CT-based design methodology for porous implants with effective stiffness matching bone was developed and evaluated using finite element simulations under physiological loading.
Result· Porous implants produced peri-implant bone mechanical responses within -6% to 10.7% of pre-implant values, showing close agreement compared to solid implants.
Validation· Validation was performed via FE simulation comparing von Mises stress and average strain on peri-implant bone against natural bone conditions.

Motivation· Metal lattice structures suffer from manufacturing defects that degrade mechanical performance, necessitating predictive models that incorporate defect information.
Method· Defects are characterized via X-ray micro-tomography and introduced into continuum and finite element models to predict stress-strain response.
Result· Including defect data improves prediction of mechanical behavior, particularly strength reductions due to disconnected struts.
Validation· Validation against experimental compression tests on SLM-fabricated lattice structures.

Motivation· To evaluate the efficacy and safety of 3D-printed porous titanium interbody fusion cages.

Motivation· To develop a biodegradable internal fixation screw with both antibacterial and anti-osteolytic properties for high-risk infection patients.
Method· Zn-2Ag alloy screws were fabricated and tested in three animal models: rat femur osteomyelitis, mouse cranial osteolysis, and rabbit femoral condyle fracture.
Result· The Zn-2Ag screws exhibited good antibacterial and anti-osteolytic effects and achieved complete fracture healing at 3 months, comparable to Ti-6Al-4V screws.
Validation· In vivo validation using multiple animal models with infection, osteolysis, and fracture fixation scenarios.

Motivation· To investigate the combined effects of nanotopography and microscale roughness on the molecular, histological, and biomechanical development of osseointegration.
Method· Colloidal lithography was used to create ordered nanotopography on machined titanium implants, which were inserted into rat tibiae for analysis of removal torque, bone-implant contact, and gene expression at multiple time points.
Result· Nanotopography superimposed on micro-rough surfaces enhanced early implant stability and bone-implant contact, while attenuating the expression of proinflammatory cytokine TNF-α.

Motivation· This work investigates the effect of various heat treatments on the corrosion resistance and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V alloy.
Method· Annealing treatments at different temperatures (730°C, 850°C, 1015°C) were applied to SLM Ti6Al4V, followed by electrochemical corrosion tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution and tensile testing.
Result· The sample heat-treated at 730°C exhibited the best corrosion resistance and excellent fracture strain, while the 1015°C treatment led to Widmanstätten structure and poor mechanical properties.
Validation· Experimental validation was carried out via electrochemical polarization curves and tensile stress-strain measurements.

Motivation· To design porous bulk metallic glasses with high strength and low weight for structural applications.

Low FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Peripheral Background only simulation_case UQ
Xiaoyu Huang, Pan Wang, Haihe Li, Zheng Zhang Xibei Gongye Daxue Xuebao/Journal of Northwestern Polytechnical University 2021-12-01 10.1051/jnwpu/20213961312
单位: Aircraft Reliability Institute, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an 710072, China
通讯: Xiaoyu Huang @ Aircraft Reliability Institute, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an 710072, China
相关性: 该论文涉及疲劳可靠性分析和主动学习Kriging模型，但应用于航空发动机涡轮盘，与生物力学植入物设计无直接关联。
边界: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on aero-engine turbine disk fatigue reliability with fuzzy failure states.
动机· 传统二元状态假设不适用于涡轮盘疲劳可靠性评估。
方法· 采用模糊失效状态假设，结合主动学习Kriging模型计算模糊失效概率。
结果· 建立了基于模糊失效概率的全局灵敏度指标，指导结构优化。
验证· 通过涡轮盘数值算例验证方法有效性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Traditional binary state assumption is inadequate for fatigue reliability evaluation of turbine disks due to loading sequence effects.
Method· A fuzzy failure state assumption is adopted, and an active learning Kriging model is used to compute fuzzy failure probability via Gaussian quadrature.
Result· A global sensitivity index based on fuzzy failure probability is established to analyze input variable influences.
Validation· The method is validated through a numerical simulation case of a turbine disk.

通讯: Cedric Kulbach @ FZI Research Center for Information Technology, Karlsruhe, Germany
相关性: 该论文关注神经网络架构搜索中的偏好引导，与FEA替代模型或生物力学设计无直接关联。
边界: No FEA, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics context; focuses on NAS with preference elicitation.
动机· 多目标NAS计算成本高，需要高效探索用户偏好。
方法· 提出交互式偏好引导方法，将用户偏好转化为损失函数。
结果· 在NATS-Bench上，该方法能逼近多样用户偏好并找到合适架构。
验证· 在标准NAS基准数据集上对比多目标方法。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Multi-objective neural architecture search is computationally expensive and requires broad exploration to approximate the Pareto front.
Method· An interactive machine learning approach based on preference elicitation that converts user preferences into a custom loss function for single-objective black-box optimization.
Result· The approach successfully approximates diverse end-user preferences and finds suitable neural architectures on the NATS-Bench benchmark.
Validation· Evaluated against multi-objective NAS algorithms on the NATS-Bench benchmark dataset.

边界: No surrogate modeling for FEA, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.
动机· 现有优化算法评估只关注质量，忽略了速度。
方法· 在标准测试函数上比较贝叶斯优化和进化算法的质量与速度。
结果· 贝叶斯优化在有限评估次数下质量更好，进化算法在足够评估次数下能找到最优解。

Motivation· Current evaluations of optimization algorithms focus solely on solution quality, neglecting computational speed.
Method· Bayesian optimization and evolutionary algorithms are compared on benchmark test functions in terms of both quality and speed.
Result· Bayesian optimization achieves better quality under limited function evaluations, while evolutionary algorithms find the global optimum given sufficient evaluations.
Validation· Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmark functions.

Motivation· To investigate the frequency of radiographic loosening around radial head prostheses and its association with lateral collateral ligament repair.
Method· A retrospective review of 25 patients who underwent radial head arthroplasty between 2012 and 2019, analyzing radiographic loosening, stress shielding, heterotopic ossification, and implant removal rates.
Result· Radiographic loosening occurred in one-third of patients within a mean follow-up of 18 months; pain was the main reason for implant removal, but no significant association with LCL repair was found.
Validation· The study is a retrospective clinical review with a small sample size and potential type II statistical error.

Motivation· Motivated by the unknown effect of habitual caffeine intake on bone-anchored implant osseointegration, this study evaluated its impact on stability and bone markers.

Motivation· To assess whether calcium-coated and chemically modified SLA dental implants can achieve osseointegration without primary mechanical stability.

Motivation· To evaluate the efficacy and safety of low-dose edoxaban for VTE prophylaxis in patients with impaired renal function after lower extremity orthopedic surgery.

Validation· Clinical retrospective cohort with multivariate regression to adjust for confounders.
